note: A 40 ms PCR that turns into a 2 s one at 60 s (B-86): the first 2 s interval crosses the 500 ms threshold three times, so the program degrades (cadence) at 61.5 s and drops the switch's overlap (about 0.6 s per PID, the reference's source lead); the interval teaches the 2 s cadence (threshold 4 s), nothing is late after it, and the program recovers 30 s after the last crossing, at 92 s, with the PCR lock re-acquired (the gap of about 0.6 s per PID at the switch back). One pair only: recovery clears the windowed counts (B-86's fix; before it the row failed again at once, five pairs 8 s apart).
